children: Tempest Therapeutics completed a private placement raising approximately $2.5 million via pre-funded warrants bundled with Series C and Series D common warrants, with potential for about $5 million more upon cash exercise of the common warrants. The company entered a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor, granted resale registration rights to facilitate liquidity, and engaged H.C. Wainwright as exclusive placement agent, paying a 7% fee and issuing agent warrants. Proceeds will support working capital and general corporate purposes, while stockholder approval is required before the common warrants become exercisable.
